name: Harbor Pack
author: JAMM
description: Two boats (Paddle Raft and Comet Cruiser) and two hats (Fisher's Beanie and Lucky Captain Hat), showcasing boat-shop paging and hat effect hooks.

boats.name: Paddle Raft
boats.description: A lashed-log raft with a wooden paddle.#Slow and cozy, holds 3 fish.

boats.name: Comet Cruiser
boats.description: A twin-stripe speedster for deep water.#Very fast and holds 14 fish.

hats.name: Fisher's Beanie
hats.description: A warm ribbed knit beanie for chilly mornings on the water.

hats.name: Lucky Captain Hat
hats.description: A gilded skipper's cap with a four-leaf clover. All caught fish sell for 15% more.
